svg.title: Full-stack engineer & founder: I build the product. And everything behind it.
svg.desc: I turn complex problems into software people use and pay for, from native iOS apps to AI-powered creator tools and the agent tools that help me build them. Scene: a DeckDrop generation demo window, the Dosely iPhone dashboard, and a card reading Built with my own tools, Explore the agent infrastructure.
